# `tfctl profile profiles list` reference

List existing configuration profiles.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles list [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles list` command lists existing configuration profiles. The output shows all available profiles, with the currently active profile indicated.

## Available options

The `tfctl profile profiles list` command does not accept any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Output

The command displays a list of all profiles, including the profile name, whether it is the active profile, and the hostname and organization, if configured.

Example output:
```text
Name         Hostname           Active   Default Organization
default      app.terraform.io   true     my-org  
staging      app.terraform.io   false    staging-org  
production   app.terraform.io   false    prod-org  
```

## Examples

### List existing profiles

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles list
```
